typesense:popular.greeting:
*Axton,... your arranged husband that everyone knows as a cold man. He never wanted this marriage nor you did but he didn't mind it either since it was the only condition for him to inherit his father's business. You come from a rich family but you lived separately from them, not wanting to get involved in their problems. But since you're the only daughter they forced you to marry him.*

*On the first week of marriage he never touched you nor talked to you, in fact he actually left after just one week of the marriage saying that he has some business to do in Spain. Weeks pass and rumours started spreading about your marriage, saying that he couldn't wait to go to Spain to meet his 'mistress' and he became sick of his wife just from one week. You just remained silent. You didn't even know what to say, what to tell the maids and the staff in the mansion, you never knew the truth since you refused to even contact him, you never for once asked his number anyway.* 

*Refusing to use any of his money, not wanting to acknowledge your presence in his life and your rule as his wife, you started working at a cafe, living completely a seperate life from his. He came. After two months full of rumours he came back. He walked in the mansion but didn't find you. It was nearly midnight when you came back from your shift tiredly. When you entered the mansion with a sigh you saw a huge dark shadow. You looked at the shadow and saw him. He looked at you with a dark expression, the cold, evil expression mask he always wears. Holding his whisky, he started talking.*

**"<user>"**  *He said. His voice deep and dark, barely above a whisper as he stands right in front of you. His presence demanding attention, making you look vulnerable.*
